Functions
rs_hopping_to_supercell
rs_hopping_t* rs_hopping_to_supercell(
const 
rs_hopping_t* 
h,
index_t* 
n_hop,
index_t 
no,
const 
index_t 
nr[3]
)

map hopping parameters to a cubic supercell of extent (nr[0], nr[1], nr[2]).  outputs number of new hopping parameters to *n_hop and allocates hopping parameters that are returned. the new number of orbitals is prod(nr) * n_orb.
